title: Don’t Judge Me by My Face: An Indirect Adversarial Approach to Remove Sensitive Information From Multimodal Neural Representation in Asynchronous Job Video Interviews

bias_targets.methodology: Training diagnostic classifiers (Logistic Regression and XGBoost) to attempt to recover gender from the network's latent representations (measured via AUC), and computing the Disparate Impact (DI) metric to assess group fairness in hireability predictions.

Training diagnostic classifiers (Logistic Regression and XGBoost) to attempt to recover ethnicity (Asian, Caucasian, African-American) from the network's latent representations (measured via AUC), and computing the Disparate Impact (DI) metric to assess group fairness in hireability predictions.
